column1: # harness contract 6: "a POSITIVE CONTROL (a subject whose expected answer
# is deliberately wrong in a fixture yields `did-not-match-as-expected`)".
# Every row is a REAL (pattern, subject, regime) of this sub-bench with its
# expectation DELIBERATELY FALSIFIED, plus a tenth column naming the
# match_outcome the judge must return. tools/selfcheck.py runs the real
# pcre2 driver over each one twice -- once against the falsified
# expectation, which must produce the named outcome, and once against the
# committed one, which must produce `matched-as-expected`. Without that
# second half the control would pass just as well if the judge disliked
# every answer it was ever shown.
# Columns: the nine of expectations.tsv, then `want`.
